description: Breakout entry (HHV20 close breakout, ER20>=0.2, buy Open t+1): raw continuation z=lnP[t+60]-lnO[t+6] when u5=lnP[t+5]-lnO[t+1] >= ln1.05 minus when u5 <= ln0.95

notes: events MAIN up 3399 / down 2868; NW lags 20; daily means over events of signal day t; entries overlap (each event = trade). Thresholds +-5% as ln(1.05)/ln(0.95); z needs a valid Open at t+6.
